title: Time Series Reasoning via Process-Verifiable Thinking Data Synthesis and Scheduling for Tailored LLM Reasoning

claim.summary: VeriTime constructs process-labeled temporal reasoning data and applies difficulty-scheduled supervised and GRPO training with process rewards.
